entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun, law, and retribution on Theros, self-declared leader of the pantheon; he murdered Elspeth, was imprisoned in the Underworld, later compleated and killed by Kaya Cassir.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god who challenged Heliod's claims, causing a schism in the pantheon.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr who achieved apotheosis and whom Heliod called a usurper.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker made Heliod's champion; he murdered her, she later shattered his spear in the Underworld.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the dead, long-time rival of Heliod, who chained Heliod beneath a boulder.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed the compleated Heliod.

entities.name: Kytheon
entities.description: Armed by Heliod to fight a Titan; his companions died and he became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker to whom Heliod gave Elspeth's corpse.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A Returned whom Heliod resurrected as a demigod.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: A god who prevented the gods from interacting with mortals in the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Khrusor
entities.description: Heliod's divine spear that could be thrown to any point on Theros.

entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: The shadow of Khrusor that Elspeth seized and used in the Underworld.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: A spear Heliod made from Purphoros' blade, given to Elspeth and later used to kill her.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Heliod was the sun god.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead where Heliod was chained.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starry realm of the gods on Theros.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Kruphix's prevention of gods interacting with mortals.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which Heliod was compleated.

entities.name: Chrome Host
entities.description: The Phyrexian faction that claimed Heliod by compleating his followers.

events.summary: Heliod arms Kytheon and sends him after a Titan sent rampaging by Erebos, leading to his companions' deaths and his ascension as a planeswalker.
events.quote: It was Heliod who armed Kytheon (later known as Gideon ) and sent him after a Titan that Erebos had sent rampaging across Theros.

events.summary: Heliod's desire for praise brings him into savage conflict with Purphoros; Purphoros' blade falls and is taken by Elspeth.
events.quote: fell from the heavens and was taken by a frightened Elspeth

events.summary: Heliod tries to burn Elspeth alive for her sword, fails, and makes her his champion, converting the blade into the spear Godsend.
events.quote: he saw fit to make her his "champion" and converted the weapon into a spear called Godsend .

events.summary: Kruphix imposes the Silence of the Gods as the pantheon goes to war.
events.quote: Kruphix saw fit to prevent the gods from interacting with the mortals

events.summary: Heliod blames Elspeth for Xenagos' apotheosis and tries unsuccessfully to kill her.
events.quote: Heliod was quick to blame Elspeth and once again tried to kill her, but failed.

events.summary: After Elspeth's battle with Xenagos in Nyx, Heliod takes Godsend and stabs her, murdering her while taunting her.
events.quote: taking Godsend away from her and stabbing her with it

events.summary: Heliod gives Elspeth's corpse to Ajani Goldmane and departs.
events.quote: He gave her corpse to Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: Heliod resurrects Daxos as a demigod at great cost while seeking to become sole god.
events.quote: Heliod sought to become the sole god of the pantheon.

events.summary: Elspeth fights Heliod at the borders of the Underworld and shatters his spear; Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder.
events.quote: chained Heliod into the Underworld beneath a giant boulder.

events.summary: Heliod is compleated when the Chrome Host compleates his followers.
events.quote: were still able to claim Heliod by compleating his followers

events.summary: Kaya Cassir kills the compleated Heliod and his body fades away.
events.quote: The compleated god was later killed by Kaya Cassir during the invasion's waning moments

relations.quote: Heliod’s rigid need for worship and control led him to murder Elspeth
